title: From prompting to evidence-based translation: A RAG+prompt system for Japanese-Chinese translation and its pedagogical potential
abstract: arXiv:2605.03387v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models perform well on high-resource pairs but are less reliable for Japanese-Chinese sentences containing noun-modifying clause constructions (NMCCs). This study evaluates a retrieval-augmented generation RAG+Prompt translation system that integrates linguistic analysis, embedding-based retrieval, prompt construction, and LLM generation without modifying the base model. The analysis module outputs A1 (inner vs. outer NMCC) and A2 (risk predictions: lexical choice/NMCC handling/word order/style/register); top-k = 5 similar Ja-Zh examples (L2 distance) and A1/A2 are inserted into an enhanced prompt. Using GPT-4o and a 66-sentence test set, we compare six knowledge-base sizes (0/100/200/500/1,000/2,000). Macro-averaged sentence-level BLEU (1-4-gram with brevity penalty; cased; Chinese at the character level) is the sole metric. translated_title: 从提示词到基于证据的翻译：面向日中翻译的RAG+提示词系统及其教学潜力
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在资源丰富的语言对上表现出色，但对于包含名词修饰节结构（NMCC）的日中句子，其可靠性较低。本研究评估了一种检索增强生成（RAG+Prompt）翻译系统，该系统集成了语言学分析、基于嵌入的检索、提示词构建和大语言模型生成，且无需修改基础模型。分析模块输出A1（内接/外接名词修饰节类型）和A2（风险预测：词汇选择/名词修饰节处理/语序/文体/语域）；检索出的top-k=5个相似日中例句（基于L2距离）连同A1/A2信息被插入到增强的提示词中。实验使用GPT-4o和66句测试集，比较了六种知识库规模（0/100/200/500/1,000/2,000）。宏平均句子级BLEU（带简短惩罚的1-4-gram；区分大小写；中文按字符级计算）作为唯一评价指标。平均BLEU从知识库为0（禁用RAG）时的24.28提升至知识库为2,000时的29.96（+5.68；提升23.4%）。[摘要原文在此处截断]
tldr: 该研究提出了一种RAG+提示词翻译系统，通过融入语言学分析和相似例句检索来增强GPT-4o，在不修改基础模型的前提下，将含名词修饰节结构的日中翻译BLEU得分提升了23.4%，并展示了其教学应用潜力。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a RAG+prompt translation system that enhances GPT-4o with linguistic analysis and retrieval of similar examples, improving BLEU by 23.4% for Japanese-Chinese translation of noun-modifying clause constructions without modifying the base model, and demonstrates its pedagogical potential.
